mutations.description: Increase weight for novelty and impact_potential while slightly decreasing coherence weight
mutations.justification: Composite scores are low (avg 0.395) with no hypotheses above 0.5 despite high bridge rate (68.5%). The current weights may be over-penalizing novel but less coherent ideas. Increasing novelty weight from 0.2 to 0.25 and impact_potential from 0.15 to 0.20 while reducing coherence from 0.3 to 0.25 should reward more ambitious, high-impact hypotheses while maintaining testability as the primary criterion.
mutations.estimated_impact: Expected 10-15% increase in average composite scores, more hypotheses scoring above 0.5 threshold
mutations.observation_summary: Score distribution shows 0 hypotheses in 0.5-0.7 and 0.7-1.0 ranges despite high bridge rate

mutations.description: Diversify exploration strategies beyond pure semantic distance
mutations.justification: Current strategy weights are 100% semantic_distance, which may limit the types of interdisciplinary connections being made. The underexplored domains (Biomaterials, Ceramics, Elastomers, Hydrogels, Molecular Biology) might benefit from anomaly-guided exploration (finding contradictions) and structural analogy (transferring frameworks). This diversification should help reach more fertile interdisciplinary zones.
mutations.estimated_impact: More diverse hypothesis generation patterns, better exploration of underexplored domains, potentially higher-quality bridges
mutations.observation_summary: Underexplored domains identified: Biomaterials, Ceramics, Elastomers, Hydrogels, Molecular Biology; current strategy is monolithic

mutations.description: Slightly increase maximum semantic distance for exploration
mutations.justification: The system is generating bridges effectively (68.5% bridge rate) but composite scores remain low. Increasing distance_max from 0.75 to 0.8 allows for slightly more distant interdisciplinary connections while staying within reasonable bounds. This may help reach more novel combinations, especially in the promising underexplored domains.
mutations.estimated_impact: 5-10% increase in novelty scores, better exploration of distant domain connections
mutations.observation_summary: High bridge rate (68.5%) but low composite scores (avg 0.395) suggests current distance range may be too conservative for generating high-novelty hypotheses

rationale: The observation report reveals several key patterns: 1) Strong score-feedback correlation (0.85) indicates the scoring system is well-calibrated, 2) Bridge rate is high (68.5%) but composite scores are low (avg 0.395) with no hypotheses scoring above 0.5, 3) Underexplored domains show promise but need targeted exploration, 4) The current strategy weights heavily favor semantic_distance (1.0) over other strategies. The mutations aim to: improve hypothesis quality by adjusting score weights to better reflect what makes a hypothesis valuable, diversify exploration strategies to reach more fertile interdisciplinary zones, and slightly increase exploration of promising domains while maintaining system stability.
expected_outcomes: Better exploration of underexplored domains (Biomaterials, Ceramics, etc.)
More diverse types of interdisciplinary connections
risks: Increased novelty weight may lead to less coherent hypotheses
Strategy diversification may initially reduce bridge rate as system adapts
Higher distance_max could increase noise in hypothesis generation
